name: refer-a-friend
title: Refer a friend
description: Customers invite friends: the deal in plain words, three steps, a personal link to copy, share options and a live count of invites, joins and credit.
docs: Pass the offer (what the friend gets and what the customer gets, as text), the customer's link, their stats (invited, joined and the credit earned so far, formatted by you), the terms (a link and a line on when credit arrives, both required) and an optional onShare that receives copy, email or native. The heading, the three steps and the share message are written from the offer unless you pass your own title, steps or message. The link sits in a read-only field that selects on focus, with a copy button that confirms in words and says so to a screen reader, and says it to a screen reader too when the browser refuses. The field wraps the link instead of cutting it, on a phone as on a wide panel, so the personal part at its end is always readable; on a narrow section the button sits under the field at full width. The email action is a mailto link with the message and link filled in, and the device's share sheet is offered only where the browser has one, which is known after mount so the markup always matches. The three tallies are a description list in tabular figures with their labels, and locale formats the counts. On a wide section the offer and the steps sit beside the link panel; on a narrow one they stack. labels translates every fixed word, the default steps and the share message. The default steps and message are generic (a first purchase, a first payment); pass your own steps and message to tell one story, such as a first month and a next invoice. The field is not CopyField, on purpose: it needs a link that wraps, words you can translate and a read-only field that selects itself.
